properties.description: crates/reflow2-mcp/tests/a_cross_design_read_takes_the_other_design_by_graph_id.rs: against a registry server holding designs A and B — a session on A with _meta reflow2/readable_graph_ids [A,B] gets a diff / composed report naming B; B absent from the set → refused naming B and saying nothing of what it holds; no _meta → refused naming the key; A's own graph_id → refused; compare_designs with a path on the registry server → refused ("a path is not served here"); A→B and B→A concurrently (6 rounds each) finish without deadlock. One in-process test and five wire tests. It is the check of dec:a-cross-design-read-is-bounded-by-the-readable-set-the-host-hands-over-not-by-the-root-alone as well.
properties.findings: 2026-10-12, 59553c771: seven tests now. Added a paging test: a diff over budget comes back within budget with summary and every count intact and every shortened list named in budget.lists_shortened; paging edges_added with list + offset across two or more pages concatenates to the unbudgeted list in order, every page within budget and budget.reply_chars equal to the page's size. 7 passed; the compare_designs case in tests/tools.rs passes; the_mcp_surface_only_grows passes with its fixture untouched.
properties.name: compare_designs and compose_and_analyse read a second design by graph_id only inside the host's readable set, refuse a path on a registry server, and do not deadlock across two designs
